name: Citizen Watch Co., Ltd.
summary: Citizen Watch Co., Ltd. functions as a global producer and vendor of timepieces and their integral components. Its operations are organized into four key divisions: Watches, Machine Tools, Devices and Components, and Electronic and Other Products. The company's diverse product range includes watch movements, various system clocks, and sophisticated manufacturing equipment like sliding and fixed headstock CNC automatic lathes. They also develop automotive components, compact switches, chip LEDs, lighting LEDs, crystal devices, motors, and printing solutions such as digital photo, POS, and barcode printers. Furthermore, their offerings extend to electronic thermometers and blood pressure monitors. Established in 1918, the firm is headquartered in Nishitokyo, Japan, and officially adopted its current name, Citizen Watch Co., Ltd., in October 2016, having previously operated as Citizen Holdings Co., Ltd.
